```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Data: https://ourworldindata.org/economic-inequality
income <- readr::read_csv("2025/data/income-share-of-the-richest-1.csv")
income_world <- income |> 
  dplyr::filter(Country == "World") |> 
  dplyr::slice_max(Year, n = 1) |> 
  dplyr::rename(Income = `Income share of the richest 1% (before tax) (World Inequality Database)`)
plot_data <- data.frame(
  type = c("People", "Wealth"),
  Yes = c(1, income_world$Income)
) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(No = 100 - Yes) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    -type, 
    values_to = "n",
    names_to = "YN"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(type == "Wealth")
ojs_define(plot_data = plot_data)
```

```{ojs}
d3 = require("d3@7")
```

```{ojs}
data = transpose(plot_data)
units = data.flatMap(d => d3.range(Math.round(d.n)).map(() => d))
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.cell(
      units,
      Plot.stackX({
        y: (_, i) => i % 5,
        fill: "YN",
        title: "YN"
      })
    ),
    Plot.text([`1% of people have 21% of the world's wealth.`], {frameAnchor:"top-left", dy:-50, fontWeight:"bold", fontSize:"18", textAnchor:"start"}),
    Plot.text([`The share of income received by the richest 1% of the population in 2023, where income is measured before payment of taxes\nand non-pension benefits but after the payment of public and private pensions.`], {frameAnchor:"top-left", dy:-27, fontSize:"14", textAnchor:"start"}),
    Plot.text([`Data: World Inequality Database (WID). Processed by Our World in Data.`], {frameAnchor:"bottom-left", dy:20, fontSize:"12", textAnchor:"start"})
  ],
  x: { axis: null },
  y: { axis: null },
  marginTop: 60,
  marginBottom: 30,
  marginLeft: 10,
  marginRight: 5,
  width: 800, height: 500,
  color: {  range: ["#ECD5DF", "#8E4162"] }
})
```
